'''Sunfell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]], following the Coronation of Empress [[Vaylin]] she was hand-picked by her to join the new [[Horizon Guard]]. In [[3630 BBY]], she held the rank of [[Imperator (Zakuulan rank)|Imperator]] and was part of the massive [[assault on Odessen]] initiated by Vaylin after breaking her chains on [[Nathema]]. While on the battlefield, Sunfell was confronted by [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Imperator Sunfell appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' '''"Chapter 8: End Times."'''
